fusions.name: Touch and Bolt
fusions.desc: A light slap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Spread Tines
fusions.desc: Gores the target with spread fingers for 24 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sudden Flinch
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Raised in Alarm
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
